title: Clocked simulation step
statement: Let $S$ be a finite-state deterministic machine over the Boolean alphabet and let $A$ be a nondeterministic machine over that alphabet, with a Boolean parameter indicating whether to loop. For an input $x$, a configuration $a$ of $A$, a natural number $j<m$, a Boolean choice $b$, and arbitrary work-tape contents and head positions for $S$, the host machine’s step from the run configuration encoding $a$ at clock position $j$ equals the run configuration encoding the result of taking one step of $A$ from $a$ using choice $b$, with clock position $j+1$.
hypotheses_covered: $S$ is a finite-state deterministic Boolean machine
arbitrary work-tape contents and head positions for $S$
